items.title: 2 Dow Jones Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: The Dow Jones (^DJI) is made up of 30 of the most established and influential companies in the market. But even blue-chip stocks can struggle - some are dealing with slowing growth, outdated business models, or increasing competition.

items.title: Romania shoots down drone that breached its airspace
items.summary: Investing.com -- A Spanish F/A-18 fighter jet operating under NATO’s air-policing mission shot down a drone that entered Romanian airspace without authorisation early on Sunday, Reuters reported, citing Romania’s defence ministry.

items.title: This Sprawling Chinese Refinery Is Bankrolling Tehran
items.summary: Hengli is accused by the U.S. of being a major importer of illicit Iranian crude; the Chinese petrochemical company denies trading with Iran.

items.title: Archer Aviation Has $6.9 Million of Revenue. It's Buying a Boeing Business With More Than $200 Million.
items.summary: Boeing hands over three subsidiaries and walks away owning about 16.5% of Archer. Insitu alone brings annual revenue 29 times Archer's own.

items.title: How 737-7 FAA Approval and New Tech Trial At Boeing (BA) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Boeing recently received an amended type certificate from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration for its 737-7 aircraft, clearing the smallest and longest-range member of the 737 MAX family for commercial service after extensive testing and safety reviews. In parallel, Odysight.ai Inc. announced a Memorandum of Agreement with Boeing to trial its computer vision-based predictive maintenance platform at two Boeing sites, highlighting Boeing’s interest in advanced monitoring technologies...

items.title: BAE Systems (LSE:BA.) Stock May Trade At A 9% Discount Despite THREADS Progress
items.summary: BAE Systems has delivered a very strong 5 year share price return, yet current checks suggest the stock now sits close to its estimated intrinsic value rather than offering an obvious discount. Over the past 5 years, BAE Systems has returned about 348.4%, which puts recent pricing under closer scrutiny for signs of over optimism or lingering value. items.title: JLL Considers Boeing’s Old HQ for Chicago Headquarters Move
